banner: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
objective: Evacuate a region; require warm capacity, synchronized state, and exclusive writer ownership.
sourceRequiredBehavior: Warm the destination region, synchronize required state, and migrate ownership and traffic safely.
sourceAcceptance: Required state and capacity exist before migration; actual regional routes and exclusive ownership converge safely.
sourceQualification: All region, topology, failure, evacuation, state, fence, writer, route and journey observations are fixed fictional teaching DATA ONLY, not actual resource, network, identity or data operations.
preconditions: Open the complete standalone bundle in a JavaScript-capable browser; no server or installation is required.
region-amber and region-violet are fictional labels, not real Azure regions or a discovered topology.
The fixed contract requires four warm capacity units, committed checkpoint 42, session availability and one eligible destination writer at epoch 8 after fencing source epoch 7.
Exactly two authored journey samples use a 120 ms budget; all results are DATA ONLY.
actions: Choose one of seven fixed independent fixtures and begin it.
Read the authored warm-capacity and synchronized-state observations in order.
Check exclusive-writer handoff; negative or unknown prerequisites retain the source owner and block traffic migration.
Only after positive prerequisites, migrate fictional traffic and inspect both authored routes and journey/effect outcomes.
Inspect earlier positive, negative and unknown history; explicitly reset after at most seven runs.
expectedAssertions: Beginning a fixture leaves all measured readiness, fencing, routes and journeys unknown.
Warm capacity and required synchronized state precede a single fenced destination writer handoff.
Cold capacity, stale state and an unfenced source/two-writer observation each block migration without source-owner mutation.
Missing observations are unknown, never inferred success or zero capacity/effects.
Positive writer handoff alone cannot certify evacuation; routes and journeys must also pass.
A stale source route blocks evacuation even when both journeys succeed.
A failed mutating journey remains interrupted and zero-effect despite positive prerequisite and route gates.
Failed evacuation retains the source origin but never automatically restores its fenced writer.
Malformed typed inputs, forged immutable state, out-of-order actions and over-budget runs fail without mutation.
Retained history, keyboard actions, focused errors, reset, restrictive CSP and read-only verification work in the actual browser.
limits: No actual region, resource, topology, outage, evacuation, route, network, state synchronization, writer fence, identity, credential, deployment or spend operation.
No clock, random simulation, remote data, framework, package installation, download or server in the lesson.
A positive result covers only the two authored samples in one fixed fixture; it cannot certify regional convergence, availability or production safety.
Each new run is an independent teaching fixture, not failback, data repair or real ownership recovery.
History is bounded and in memory; explicit reset or page reload clears it.
B-S113 and D-S113 remain incomplete and separately gated. One original frozen Kano S unit only; no test, evidence, repair or refinement credits.
Node 22.23.4 is local test tooling, not production Node 24 validation.
Offline Playwright 1.56.1 and installed Microsoft-signed Edge 156 use the published isolated helper only. The inactive lifecycle prototype is unqualified.
